To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the concentration of benzene in brine can serve as a reconnaissance geochemical tool for hydrocarbon exploration in the Niger Delta.

the analysis of brine samples for benzene concentrations can be a cost effective, reliable and rapid tool for hydrocarbon exploration in the study area and can serve as an alternative tool to the conventional seismic and drilling exploration methods.

the concentrations of Benzene in brine from two test wells, located in the study area, were analyzed and the results obtained were compared to the concentrations obtained from other wells in the study area and it was discovered that the concentrations of 5.0-6.5ppm of Benzene obtained from the test wells are within the range of concentrations obtained from other nearby wells and that the concentrations of the Benzene obtained from other wells correspond to the presence of oil in the study area.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of brine concentrations as a reconnaissance geochemical tool in oil exploration.
the application of brine concentrations in petroleum exploration.
the application of brine concentration as a reconnaissance geochemical tool for hydrocarbon exploration.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the application of brine concentration as a reconnaissance geochemical tool for hydrocarbon exploration is a viable and reliable tool for hydrocarbon prospecting.
the analysis of brine concentrations can serve as a useful geochemical tool in hydrocarbon exploration in the study area, and other similar hydrocarbon bearing sedimentary basins in the world.

the analysis of brine concentrations of benzene can be used to determine the approximate distance from the drill depth to the top of hydrocarbon accumulations in a hydro-geological system, provided there is a nearby accumulation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the concentrations of Benzene can serve as an exploratory tool for hydrocarbon prospecting and can be applied in the study area and other similar areas.

benzene concentration in brine can serve as an effective reconnaissance geochemical exploration tool for hydrocarbon prospecting and exploration in the Niger Delta and other sedimentary basins in the world.
the concentrations of Benzene in brine samples can be used to determine the approximate distance from dry hole to a hydrocarbon reservoir in the same geologic system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the concentration of benzene in brine can be used to map the plume of petroleum constituents emanating out from nearby oil accumulations.

the concentration of benzene in brine samples from the same hydrogeologic system as an oil prospect can be used as a reconnaissance geochemical tool to estimate the approximate distance to the top of an oil prospect in the Niger Delta.
the concentrations of hydrocarbons in the brine can be used as a reconnaissance geochemical exploratory technique in the search for petroleum in a hydrogeologic system.
